const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Interactive controller for the limited RoboLab put_mugs_on_shelf episode.
+
+Run with `/opt/venv/bin/python /app/output/gen.py` (or the active Python).
+The process keeps one Robot client alive and accepts JSON commands on stdin.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output/observations')
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+print(json.dumps({'spec': r.spec(), 'status': r.status()}), flush=True)
+
+
+def dump_result(res, label):
+    d = OUT / label
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, im in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(im)).save(d / f'{cam}.jpg', quality=95)
+    if res.proprio is not None:
+        np.save(d / 'proprio.npy', res.proprio)
+    (d / 'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2, default=lambda x: np.asarray(x).tolist()))
+    return {'meta': res.meta, 'last_shapes': {k: list(v.shape) for k, v in res.last.items()},
+            'proprio_shape': None if res.proprio is None else list(res.proprio.shape)}
+
+
+for raw in sys.stdin:
+    try:
+        cmd = json.loads(raw)
+        op = cmd['op']
+        if op == 'obs':
+            res = r.get_obs(seconds=cmd.get('seconds', 0), video=cmd.get('video', 'none'))
+            out = dump_result(res, cmd['label'])
+            if res.video:
+                for cam, data in res.video.items():
+                    (OUT / cmd['label'] / f'{cam}.mp4').write_bytes(data)
+            if res.frames:
+                for cam, frames in res.frames.items():
+                    fd = OUT / cmd['label'] / cam
+                    fd.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+                    for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
+                        Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(frame)).save(fd / f'{i:04}.jpg', quality=90)
+            out['frames'] = {k: list(v.shape) for k, v in res.frames.items()}
+            print(json.dumps(out, default=lambda x: np.asarray(x).tolist()), flush=True)
+        elif op == 'submit':
+            res = r.submit(cmd['type'], cmd['actions'], dt=cmd.get('dt', 1/15),
+                           video=cmd.get('video', 'none'), note=cmd.get('note', ''))
+            out = dump_result(res, cmd['label'])
+            if res.video:
+                for cam, data in res.video.items():
+                    (OUT / cmd['label'] / f'{cam}.mp4').write_bytes(data)
+            if res.frames:
+                for cam, frames in res.frames.items():
+                    fd = OUT / cmd['label'] / cam
+                    fd.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+                    for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
+                        Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(frame)).save(fd / f'{i:04}.jpg', quality=90)
+            out['frames'] = {k: list(v.shape) for k, v in res.frames.items()}
+            out['done'] = res.done
+            print(json.dumps(out, default=lambda x: np.asarray(x).tolist()), flush=True)
+            if res.done:
+                break
+        elif op == 'status':
+            print(json.dumps(r.status()), flush=True)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f'unknown operation {op}')
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(json.dumps({'error': type(e).__name__, 'message': str(e)}), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
